content.title: Oscars 2026 Winners: See the Complete List
content.text: The Oscar winners 2026 complete list is here! The 98th Academy Awards ceremony is in the books and all of the films and artists honored during Hollywood's Biggest Night can be found right here. We have a full rundown of all the nominees and winners below. "One Battle After Another" earned six wins including Best Picture as well as Directing and Writing (Adapted Screenplay) honors for Paul Thomas Anderson. "Sinners," which had previously set a record with 16 nominations, took home four Oscars including Ryan Coogler's win for Writing (Original Screenplay) and Actor in a Leading Role honors for Michael B. Jordan. Jesse Buckley, Sean Penn and Amy Madigan also came away with Oscars in an acting category. "Frankenstein" earned three Oscars. "KPop Demon Hunters" was a winner for Animated Feature Film while its hit tune "Golden" received an Original Song Oscar. Read on for the complete list of nominations and winners for Oscar 2026! 98th ACADEMY AWARDS WINNERS & NOMINEES Best Picture BUGONIA Ed Guiney & Andrew Lowe, Yorgos Lanthimos, Emma Stone and Lars Knudsen, Producers F1 Chad Oman, Brad Pitt, Dede Gardner, Jeremy Kleiner, Joseph Kosinski and Jerry Bruckheimer, Producers FRANKENSTEIN Guillermo del Toro, J.
